title: Slept 10 Hours… Still Exhausted? 🔋
caption:
You slept 10 hours, took the weekend off, and woke up more tired.

In 2019 the World Health Organization described burnout with 3 signs: exhaustion, feeling distant or cynical about work, and doing worse at it. Rest stops working because the problem is how you live. Talking to someone isn't weakness. It's maintenance.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
